## Output

- `<schema>/models.go` — one Go package per schema, one struct per table.
- `migrate.go` — a factory `Registry` (with a preloaded `Default`) that migrates every model in one call; emitted when the `go_module` opt is set. Call `Default.EnsureSchemas(db)` before `Default.Migrate(db)` so the schema-qualified tables have their Postgres schemas.
- Nullable columns are pointer types; proto enums become string-typed Go enums.
- Attach in main: `Default.EnsureSchemas(db)` then `Default.Migrate(db)`, or wire the structs into a `*gorm.DB` and run AutoMigrate yourself.
- `<schema>/<model>_store.go` — a typed CRUD store per resource (Create, GetByID, List, Count, Update, DeleteByID, plus GetBy/ListBy finders for unique and foreign-key columns); emitted when the `stores` opt is set (which also requires `go_module`). Requires `gorm.io/gorm`.
- `gormx/gormx.go` — the shared runtime every store imports: `ListOptions`, the generic `Store[M]` interface every store satisfies, a `GenericStore[M]` engine that runs CRUD for any model with no per-entity code, and `EnsureSchemas`. Lets one generic engine drive every entity.
- `telemetry/telemetry.go` — the first-party telemetry adapter: `New(o)` wraps an SDK handle as the `gormx.Telemetry` the stores observe through (`WithTelemetry(telemetry.New(o))`), and `Plugin(o)` is the SQL-level gorm plugin. Emitted with the `telemetry` opt; requires `github.com/the-protobuf-project/telemetry/telemetry-go`.
- `Registry.Instrument(db, o)` in `migrate.go` — installs the generated telemetry gorm plugin so every query emits a span (and metric) through the SDK handle.

### `VehicleProfileRentalPref` → `vehicle_profile_rental_prefs`

Vehicle rental preferences can be specified for customers or companies to indicate their preferences for types of vehicles to be rented in specific travel situations. Companies may wish to specify certain class or types of cars that their employees are allowed to rent, or indicate special business needs for trucks for hauling goods, etc. Personal travelers may wish to indicate preferences for types of vehicles such as vans or SUVs for family vacations, or smaller, more sporty models when travelling alone. A customer may prefer to have a convertible or sun roof in a warm destination, but request a ski rack when vacationing in the wintertime. The VehicleProfileRentalPrefType complex type has elements for specific features on rental cars including vehicle type (major category such as car, truck, SUV) and vehicle class (more precise kind of vehicle), air conditioning, transmission, and special equipment. In addition, the specification captures preferences for vendors and loyalty programs, insurance coverage, forms of payment for rental cars, and other special requirements.

### `Rate` → `rates`

The Rate contains a collection of elements that define the amount of the rate, associated fees, additional occupant amounts as well as payment and cancellation policies. Taxes can be broken out or included within the various amounts. A currency can be associated to each amount The applicable period of the the rate are indicated by the effective dates. Restrictions that may apply to that rate, such as the minimum or maximum length of stay, stay-over dates (such as a Saturday night), min/max guests applicable for the rate, and age group (ex Adult) are attributes of Rate. It indicates the number of units that the quoted rate is based upon, as well as the TimeUnits type used that the rate is based upon, e.g.: 3days at $100.00 per day.

## Schema `stay`

### `Stay` → `resource`

Provides details of a guest's stay. A singleton (AIP-156 <https://aip.dev/156>) resource, named "hotels/{hotel}/reservations/{reservation}/stay". OTA: OTA_HotelStayInfoNotifRQ/StayInfos/StayInfo.

| Column | Type | Null |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `name` | `VARCHAR(255)` | not null |
| `uid` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `etag` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `create_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | not null |
| `update_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | not null |
| `sequence_number` | `INTEGER` | nullable |
| `room_stay_rph` | `INTEGER` | nullable |

## Schema `commission`

### `Commission` → `resource`

The CommissionEvent element is used to identify the commission to be paid to a central server. The Commission Event is initiated on the schedule that the hotel typically pays commissions (e.g.: following night audit), and a CommissionEvent occurs for every check out. A collection resource, named "hotels/{hotel}/commissions/{commission}". OTA: OTA_HotelCommNotifRQ/CommissionEvents/CommissionEvent.

### `AffiliationInfo` → `resource`

Provides information regarding affiliations, loyalty programs and award ratings. A singleton (AIP-156 <https://aip.dev/156>) resource, named "hotels/{hotel}/affiliationInfo". OTA: OTA_HotelDescriptiveContentNotifRQ/HotelDescriptiveContents/HotelDescriptiveContent/AffiliationInfo.

### `Money` → `moneys`

An amount of money in a currency, after google.type.Money. OTA's Amount, CurrencyCode and DecimalPlaces become this: DecimalPlaces scales an integral Amount (8500 with DecimalPlaces 2 is 85.00), so it is applied on the way in and not kept. See docs/conventions.md rule 13.

| Column | Type | Null |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `currency_code` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `units` | `BIGINT` | nullable |
| `nano_units` | `INTEGER` | nullable |

### `TimeOfDay` → `time_of_days`

A time of day with no date or time zone, after google.type.TimeOfDay. Its fields are singular -- hour, not hours -- because AIP-142 reads seconds and nanos as claims that a field is a time.

## Schema `hotelproduct`

### `HotelProduct` → `resource`

Specifies product information for a hotel. A product may be a room type, a rate plan, a room type rate plan combination or hotel policy information. This may be used for sending products at multiple hotels or multiple products at a single hotel. A collection resource, named "hotels/{hotel}/hotelProducts/{hotel_product}". OTA: OTA_HotelProductNotifRQ/HotelProducts/HotelProduct.

| `day_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |
| `clock_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |

### `Money` → `moneys`

An amount of money in a currency, after google.type.Money. OTA's Amount, CurrencyCode and DecimalPlaces become this: DecimalPlaces scales an integral Amount (8500 with DecimalPlaces 2 is 85.00), so it is applied on the way in and not kept. See docs/conventions.md rule 13.

| Column | Type | Null |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `currency_code` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `units` | `BIGINT` | nullable |
| `nano_units` | `INTEGER` | nullable |

### `Decimal` → `decimals`

An exact decimal number, after google.type.Decimal. OTA's xs:decimal values -- percentages, rates, measurements -- are carried as their decimal string so no precision is lost to binary floating point.

| Column | Type | Null |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `value` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |

A collection of booking rules. Booking rules can be sent separately in the HotelBookingRuleNotif message or as part of the RatePlanNotif.

| Column | Type | Null |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `inventory_info_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |

### `Rate` → `rates`

An individual rate, which is a collection of amounts by guest, additional guests, fees, collection of related guarantee, cancel and payment policies, a description and the unique id to identify the rate. Rate restrictions can be sent along with the rate as attributes of this rate. The indivual rate can also be qualified by the inventory information (InventoryGroup attribute group).

| `max_guest_applicable` | `INTEGER` | nullable |
| `age_qualifying_code` | `AgeQualifyingCode` | nullable |

## Schema `restriction`

### `Restriction` → `resource`

The AvailStatusMessage. It is here that one indicates whether the inventory is opened, closed, closed on request, etc. The MinMaxLOSStatusMessage class communicates the set of minimum and maximum length-of-stay availability status changes to be synchronized with another system. The RateHurdleStatusMessage class defines the setting for rate hurdle controls to be synchronized with the central reservation system. A collection resource, named "hotels/{hotel}/ratePlans/{rate_plan}/restrictions/{restriction}". OTA: OTA_HotelAvailNotifRQ/AvailStatusMessages/AvailStatusMessage.

## Schema `eventreport`

### `EventReport` → `resource`

Provides the actual event information. A collection resource, named "eventReports/{event_report}". OTA: OTA_HotelPostEventNotifRQ/EventReports/EventReport.

| Column | Type | Null |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `name` | `VARCHAR(255)` | not null |
| `uid` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `etag` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `delete_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | nullable |
| `expire_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | nullable |
| `create_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | not null |
| `update_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | not null |
| `time_stamp_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | nullable |
| `rph` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `version_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |
| `general_event_info_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |

### `Decimal` → `decimals`

An exact decimal number, after google.type.Decimal. OTA's xs:decimal values -- percentages, rates, measurements -- are carried as their decimal string so no precision is lost to binary floating point.

| Column | Type | Null |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `value` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |

## Schema `inventoryblock`

### `InventoryBlock` → `resource`

This is for creating a single block at a single hotel. A collection resource, named "hotels/{hotel}/inventoryBlocks/{inventory_block}". OTA: OTA_HotelInvBlockNotifRQ/InvBlocks/InvBlock.

| Column | Type | Null |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `name` | `VARCHAR(255)` | not null |
| `uid` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `etag` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `delete_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | nullable |
| `expire_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | nullable |
| `create_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | not null |
| `update_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | not null |
| `booking_status` | `BookingAvailability` | nullable |
| `inv_block_type_code` | `InventoryBlockType` | nullable |
| `inv_block_grouping_code` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `inv_block_display_name` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `inv_block_long_display_name` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `inv_block_status_code` | `InventoryBlockStatusCode` | nullable |
| `pms_inv_block_id` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `opportunity_id` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `inv_block_company_id` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `restricted_booking_code_lists` | `` | nullable |
| `restricted_viewing_code_lists` | `` | nullable |
| `transaction_detail` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `quote_id` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `destination_system_codes` | `VARCHAR(255)[]` | nullable |
| `hotel_id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `inv_block_dates_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |
| `method_info_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |
| `tax_info_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |
| `guarantee_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |

### `InvBlockDates` → `inv_block_dates`

This is used to indicate the date or date range applicable to this inventory block.

| Column | Type | Null |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `duration` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `end_date_extension_indicator` | `BOOLEAN` | nullable |
| `offset_duration` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `offset_calculation_mode` | `OffsetCalculationMode` | nullable |
| `start_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |
| `end_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |
| `absolute_cutoff_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |

### `InvBlockRoom` → `inv_block_rooms`

Used to define the room types and all of their supporting data within a room block.

| Column | Type | Null |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `duration` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `room_type_code` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `inventory_block_id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `start_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |
| `end_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |

## Schema `meetingrfp`

### `MeetingRfp` → `resource`

This is the request data for an event, whether it be a block of rooms and/or meeting space. A collection resource, named "meetingRfps/{meeting_rfp}". OTA: OTA_HotelRFP_MeetingRQ/RFP_RequestSegments/RFP_RequestSegment.

| Column | Type | Null |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `name` | `VARCHAR(255)` | not null |
| `uid` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `etag` | `VARCHAR(255)` | nullable |
| `delete_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | nullable |
| `expire_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | nullable |
| `create_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | not null |
| `update_time` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | not null |
| `room_block_indicator` | `BOOLEAN` | nullable |
| `event_block_indicator` | `BOOLEAN` | nullable |
| `proposal_spec_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |
| `dates_id` | `CHAR(26)` | not null |
| `room_block_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |
| `event_block_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |

| `rfp_published_day_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |
| `rfp_creation_day_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |
| `presentation_id` | `CHAR(26)` | nullable |

A collection of Profiles or Unique IDs of Profiles.

| Column | Type | Null |
| --- | --- | --- |
